flow.name: cie-referral-salesforce-sync
flow.doc:name: CIE Salesforce Order Sync
flow.doc:description: Polls CIE for orders, converts the response to Java, and upserts records into Salesforce

scheduler.doc:name: Poll schedule for CIE Referral
scheduler.doc:description: Triggers the flow on a fixed interval; no cadence was specified, so this defaults to every 5 minutes

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- [{ Record_Type__c: "cieReferral", Entity_Type__c: "CIE Referral", External_Unique_Identifier__c: write(vars.orderResponse.details map { "Identifier": $.uniqueIdentifier, "Id": $.uniqueIdentifierValue },"application/json") as String, Error_Message__c: vars.orderResponse.details.errorMessage default error.description, Flow_Name__c: flow.name, Error_Timestamp__c: now(), Resolution_Status__c: "Open", Correlation_Id__c: correlationId }]

flow.name: cie-assessment-salesforce-sync
flow.doc:name: CIE Assessment Salesforce Sync
flow.doc:description: Polls CIE for Housing Deposit assessments created by SDWC/Wellness Collaborative users, matches each to a Salesforce Member and open Case, and upserts the assessment record
